§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Sanzu Residual Steam can be collected in Prosperity's Sanzu River. Distillation separates fluorine, hydrogen, nitrogen, methane, and Active Fungal Suspension while leaving a mineral liquor; downstream products include cinnabar, redstone, and fluorite. Check one named raw-fluid cell filled with §11000§r mB of Sanzu Residual Steam. §2The cell is not consumed§r; building the industrial line is not required.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Collect the raw fluid in its biome before planning condensation, distillation, and mineral-water processing. Distillation of Sanzu Residual Steam Condensate directly produces §13000§r mB of Active Fungal Suspension at its highest used fluid-output layer, layer §19§r. Collect it there for downstream organic-product processing. Gases, Active Fungal Suspension, and mineral byproducts need separate downstream arrangements; distillation alone does not yield every final product. Preserve one full raw-fluid cell for this inventory goal. During industrial processing, check fraction and aqueous-phase outlets and storage separately.
